## Professional Background

Vasilis Totskas is a Fullstack Developer based in Athens, Greece, with a strong focus on high-performance web applications and scalable infrastructure. He has been working professionally since 2019, starting as a freelance web developer before joining Advisable in 2020 where he continues to work today.

At Advisable, he works on complex web applications, modernizing technology stacks and delivering projects using standalone PHP/TypeScript/Python stacks and Nuxt 4 frontends for clients. He has also built comprehensive client-facing platforms with frontends built entirely on Nuxt 4.

## Notable Projects

### GrooveShop E-commerce Platform
A multi-repository e-commerce platform built over 4+ years as a personal project. Consists of:
- **Django REST API**: Backend service handling business logic, authentication, and data management
- **Nuxt 4 Storefront**: Modern frontend application for the e-commerce experience
- **NestJS Media Streaming Service**: Dedicated microservice for media content delivery
- **Infrastructure**: PostgreSQL database with Docker orchestration

GitHub: https://github.com/vasilistotskas/grooveshop-django-api

### Webside.gr
A production e-commerce store powered by the GrooveShop platform, deployed on a self-hosted infrastructure:
- Hetzner k3s Kubernetes cluster
- ArgoCD for GitOps deployment
- Longhorn for distributed storage
- RabbitMQ for message queuing
- Celery for background task processing
- Redis for caching
- Cert-Manager for automated TLS certificates

Live: https://webside.gr

### Developer Portfolio (This Site)
A terminal/code-themed personal portfolio built with modern web technologies:
- Next.js 15 with App Router
- React 19
- TypeScript 5.7 (strict mode)
- Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first configuration)
- next-intl v4 for internationalization (English and Greek)
- Spotify API integration (now playing, top tracks)
- GitHub API integration (stats display)
- Motion library for animations
- Deployed to Vercel via GitHub Actions

Live: https://vasilistotskas.com
Source: https://github.com/vasilistotskas/nextjs-portfolio

## Site Structure

This portfolio website is available in two languages (English and Greek) and contains the following pages:

### Home (/)
- Hero section with terminal-themed introduction
- Skills overview organized by category (Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Tools)
- Featured projects with descriptions and links
- Professional experience timeline
- GitHub statistics

### About (/about)
- Detailed biography in a terminal-styled README format
- Current work description
- Projects and infrastructure overview
- Core tech stack breakdown
- Professional highlights (years of experience, certifications, languages)
- Education and certification details
- Contact information
- GitHub statistics
- Spotify top tracks integration

### Contact (/contact)
- Contact form (name, email, subject, message)
- Email address
- Location
- Social media links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter)

## Technical Implementation Details

### Theming
The site uses a terminal/code aesthetic with a custom theming system:
- Semantic CSS variables for light and dark modes
- Dark mode default with next-themes (class-based switching)
- Custom utility classes: .glass, .glow-green, .card-hover, .text-gradient, .terminal-border
- Color tokens: terminal-bg, terminal-surface, terminal-text, terminal-green, terminal-cyan, terminal-yellow, terminal-purple, terminal-muted, terminal-comment, terminal-prompt

### Fonts
- Geist Sans (primary)
- Geist Mono (monospace/code elements)

### API Routes
- /api/contact — Email sending via Resend
- /api/github — GitHub statistics proxy
- /api/spotify/now-playing — Current Spotify track (Edge Runtime)
- /api/spotify/top-tracks — Top Spotify tracks
